coverage.method: Reviewed all 86 pages on 15 contact sheets and the 19 ICC-affected math/table pages at full resolution. Following the front-matter revision, reinspected pages 1-3 at full resolution and on the regenerated first contact sheet; independently verified exact RGB identity for all 83 remaining pages against the retained prior candidate manifest.

findings: Cover title, by/name block, degree information and spacing are legible and aligned.
Adviser/second-reader block and pending-approval note fit below the abstract without overlapping the footer. Abstract ii aligns correctly in the contents; all chapter/appendix entries remain intact.
Bellman/Snell, drift-persistence and Hoeffding equations retain intact mathematical glyphs and readable proofs.
All inspected scientific tables retain clear headers, cell separation, captions and visible interval endpoints. No clipping or overlap observed.
Figures and captions remain together; Appendix B/C headings attach to their content; references and Appendix D formulas remain readable.
No blank page, missing glyph, detached caption or perceptible ICC color regression observed across the reviewed set.

validator_evidence.scope: Existing validator results read from the parent-owned candidate build manifest; validation was not rerun by this reviewer.

limitations: This is a visual review of the exact archival draft candidate, not committee approval or institutional format acceptance.
PDF/A-2b conformance does not establish accessibility/tagging or acceptance for deposit.
No defense, signature, deposit or degree-clearance event is inferred.
